digest.component_or_area: LLM provider resolution and OpenAI integration
propositions: Hosted OpenAI (bare openai:/gpt-*/o1/o3/chatgpt with no custom endpoint) must resolve to openai-responses: by default instead of openai-chat:
Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints (top-level base_url, per-class endpoint, or per-candidate endpoint) must continue resolving to openai-chat: with no deprecation warning
Explicit openai-chat: qualifier is a deprecated compatibility surface that emits a once-per-run deprecation notice pointing to openai-responses: and is scheduled for removal in v1.0.0
Provider resolution logic across config.py, providers.py, model_classes.py, and runner.py must thread endpoint information to determine correct provider qualifier (openai-responses vs openai-chat)
Contract tests must pass for both openai-responses: and openai-chat: paths covering structured output, streaming, tool calls, retries, and custom base URLs
